body.purpose: Clear product explanation and UI copy.

label.purpose: Coordinates, timestamps, sources, and numeric state.

shadows.name: product-plane
shadows.purpose: Only for major product planes entering the network field.

motion.name: scroll-link
motion.purpose: Causal network and workspace transitions only.

components.name: Marketing Primary Button
components.description: Primary conversion action on dark marketing surfaces.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.15rem; border: 1px solid #0f766e; border-radius: .35rem; background: #0f766e; color: #fff; font: 720 .82rem Geist, Arial, sans-serif; transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background 160ms; } .ds-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #116f68; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4fb7ac; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Evidence Panel
components.description: Compact product-true plane for health, ownership, and next action.
components.css: .ds-panel { display: grid; gap: .75rem; padding: 1.2rem; border: 1px solid rgba(232,240,238,.24); border-radius: .5rem; background: #0d100f; color: #f1f5f4; font-family: Geist, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-panel small { color: #9ba5a2; font: 600 .67rem 'Geist Mono', monospace; } .ds-panel strong { color: #d6a94a; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: #9ba5a2; }

narrative.overview: Waslix pairs a calm authenticated workspace with a cinematic public control surface. Customer evidence visibly moves from disconnected signals to explainable health and accountable work.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Brand teal means identity or interaction; green, amber, and red retain their business meaning everywhere.

rules.name: The Bounded Depth Rule
rules.body: Spatial depth belongs to the persistent network and major product transitions, never every card or control.

dos: Show evidence, ownership, timing, and action together.
Use motion to explain causality and continuity.
donts: Do not use generic neon gradients, decorative glass, or random 3D objects.
Do not fabricate customer proof, integrations, or AI claims.
